payload.title: Synchronize visuals with generated speech and reuse cached audio
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given a narration edit, when generation runs, then only affected speech is regenerated and cue-relative visuals follow measured audio durations. Cache identity includes all output-affecting inputs such as model/version, voice/reference, speed, seed, pronunciation, and text; reconcile this with Auritus’s existing cache contract rather than silently breaking it. Persist audio, timing, and provenance so exports can reuse identical assets even when model output is not bitwise reproducible.

## Ownership
specification, toolchain, cli, player, videoml-org; Auritus owns reusable model backends

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
